comment: Named exceptions to the 12px type floor. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can disagree with. A label that does not fit at 12px is a label that is too long — this file is not for those.

selectors.reason: components/reading-view.tsx draws a page as a 186px-wide thumbnail with aria-hidden="true". It is an image of a document, not text anyone reads; the type inside it is at page scale, not UI scale. The real fix is the one the design direction asks for — replace the drawn facsimile with the real page raster — and it belongs to the lane that owns reading-view.tsx.

filesComment: Stylesheets still under the floor when the token lane swept the sheets it owns. Each one belongs to another lane in the 2026-09-17 brand-quality campaign and is listed as a debt, not a dispensation: delete the entry with the sweep. The check still runs on every file named here — known_issues is the count it had at handover, and a sheet that gets worse fails the build. `node scripts/check-type-floor.mjs --census` prints the current numbers.
